name: Wicomico County, MD
findings: Wicomico County has 387 nonprofit organizations. 159 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 128 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wicomico County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Wicomico County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 103 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
